stem: Find the third proportional of the numbers $8, 6, \ldots\ldots, 12$. The four numbers are proportional, so $8 : 6 = \text{third} : 12$, which is the same as $6 : 8 = 12 : \text{third}$. Drag the right pan until the balance is level to find the third proportional.
solution: Let the third proportional be $x$. The numbers $8, 6, x, 12$ are proportional, so $\frac{8}{6}=\frac{x}{12}$.
Product of extremes = product of means: $8\times 12 = 6\times x$, so $96 = 6x$.

hints.text: Equal ratios have equal quotients: write the proportion as two fractions and compare them rather than multiplying numbers across within one ratio.
Use the product of the extremes equals the product of the means to get an equation for the missing number, then divide.

notes: Rewritten as 6/8 = 12/x so the unknown is the fourth term; fourth term 16.
